notes: The third locative (וְעָרֵי מָדָי) writes no preposition of its own; its *in* is read as the distributed scope of the written בְּ under rule 25, on the model of `מִבּוֹא בְדָמִים וְהוֹשֵׁעַ` → *from ... and from ...*. Leaving it to the noun under rule 33 was the competing reading.
The directive he takes the written *unto* (rule 32) and אַשּׁוּרָה's name token keeps only *Assyria*.
